sections.label: Head
sections.text:
Vertigo with headache and nausea, Disten-
sive pressure. Aches from nape of neck, spreading up-
wards ; better wrapping head up warmly. [Sil.] Flushes

708


in face ; violent pulsating. Supraorbital neuralgia ;
pains increase and decrease slowly. [5’/a»n.] Bloody
crusts in nose. Face red; burns, itches. Itching, red-
ness and burning of nose.

sections.label: Eyes
sections.text:
Burning and redness of eyes. Pain and
lachrymation on using eyes, with dancing and chromatic
alterations of objects looked at.

sections.label: Stomach
sections.text:
Loss of appetite, aversion to meat,
craves bread and beer. Food tasteless. Eructations
after eating.

sections.label: Abdomen
stool
sections.text:
[Ratanh,] Uncomfortable fullness and swelling
of abdomen.

sections.label: Extremities
sections.text:
Sciatica with oedema of ankle. Rheu-
matic pam in right shouldci. Gnawing as if in mar-
row of bones. Cramps in calves and soles. Chronic
spasms, particularly of ankle-joint. Oidematous swell-
ing. Icy-cold feet. Rheumatic pains, especially in
joints. Veins of hands engorged.

sections.label: Fever
sections.text: Heal, with, aversion to uncover or undress.

sections.label: Skin
sections.text:
Moist, itching, burning eruption; better in
open air. especially warm sunshine. Sprains of ankle-
joint, with oedema. Violent perspiration at night.

sections.label: Relationship
sections.text:
Compare: Arnica; Ruta; StL; Baryta
r.; Carbo.; Stront. jodat. (arterio-sclerosis.) Stront^
turn brom. (often gives excellent results where a bro-
mide is indicated. Vomiting of pregnancy.).
